derivation: tag = int(SHA-256(ascii_name)) mod field_modulus, where field_modulus is the BN254 scalar field modulus from poseidon2-bn254-v1.json

tags.DDTM_ROW_V1: domain tag for a data-row leaf; binds schema hash, row index and the 18 packed row field elements
tags.DDTM_PADDING_V1: domain tag for a padding leaf; binds schema hash and leaf index
tags.DDTM_NODE_V1: domain tag for an internal Merkle node; binds the tree level and the two child nodes (level participation prevents cross-level structural ambiguity)
tags.DDTM_SCHEMA_V1: reserved domain tag for schema-commitment leaves (not used by the v1 data root)
